query:
-- Create publication_methods junction table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `publication_methods` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `publication_id` int NOT NULL,
  `method_id` int NOT NULL,
  `is_primary` boolean DEFAULT false,
  `notes` text,
  UNIQUE KEY `unique_pub_method` (`publication_id`, `method_id`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`publication_id`) REFERENCES `research_publications`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (`method_id`) REFERENCES `analytical_methods`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

-- Create publication_researchers junction table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `publication_researchers` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `publication_id` int NOT NULL,
  `researcher_id` int NOT NULL,
  `role` enum('lead','corresponding','co-author') DEFAULT 'co-author',
  `author_order` int,
  UNIQUE KEY `unique_pub_researcher` (`publication_id`, `researcher_id`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`publication_id`) REFERENCES `research_publications`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (`researcher_id`) REFERENCES `researchers`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

-- Create researcher_institutions junction table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `researcher_institutions` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `researcher_id` int NOT NULL,
  `institution_id` int NOT NULL,
  `is_primary` boolean DEFAULT true,
  `start_year` int,
  `end_year` int,
  `position` varchar(255),
  UNIQUE KEY `unique_researcher_institution` (`researcher_id`, `institution_id`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`researcher_id`) REFERENCES `researchers`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (`institution_id`) REFERENCES `research_institutions`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

-- Create publication_molecules junction table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `publication_molecules` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `publication_id` int NOT NULL,
  `molecule_id` int NOT NULL,
  `study_type` enum('source','product','analyte','reference') DEFAULT 'analyte',
  `notes` text,
  UNIQUE KEY `unique_pub_molecule` (`publication_id`, `molecule_id`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`publication_id`) REFERENCES `research_publications`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (`molecule_id`) REFERENCES `molecules`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

-- Create publication_transformations junction table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `publication_transformations` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `publication_id` int NOT NULL,
  `transformation_id` int NOT NULL,
  `is_key_finding` boolean DEFAULT false,
  `notes` text,
  UNIQUE KEY `unique_pub_transformation` (`publication_id`, `transformation_id`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`publication_id`) REFERENCES `research_publications`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (`transformation_id`) REFERENCES `molecular_transformations`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
